tools.name: cc0pedia

The agentic read API over the largest machine-readable CC0 database. Synchronous JSON (no polling). [PAID: $0.01 U

tools.name: cc0pedia-search
tools.description: Free-text search over the largest machine-readable CC0 database — up to 25 ranked matches (slug, title, kind, license, on-chain contract). The 'find candidates' call before a cc0pedia lookup. Synchronous JSON, $0.01/search. [PAID: $0.01 USDC per call via x402]

tools.name: cc0pedia-verify
tools.description: License oracle: pass a contract address, get whether it's a documented CC0 work + full provenance (creator, chain, standard, supply, sources). The 'is this safe to reuse?' check before touching on-chain art. Synchronous JSON, $0.01/check. [PAID: $0.01 USDC per call via x402]

tools.name: cc0pedia-market

tools.name: tcgenerate-random

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: liminal-http-headers-91moXQ, liminal-url-to-text-yj6VKg · Private data: cc0pedia, cc0pedia-search, cc0pedia-market, cc0-print, liminal-stack-intel-7g6WFg, liminal-email-deliverability-YrGJ-Q, liminal-dns-lookup-xvSPfA · Public sink: cc0-print, liminal-email-deliverability-YrGJ-Q, van-gogh-gen.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: liminal-http-headers-91moXQ, liminal-url-to-text-yj6VKg · Private data: cc0pedia, cc0pedia-search, cc0pedia-market, cc0-print, liminal-stack-intel-7g6WFg, liminal-email-deliverability-YrGJ-Q, liminal-dns-lookup-xvSPfA · Public sink: cc0-print, liminal-email-deliverability-YrGJ-Q, van-gogh-gen

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
